nodes.label: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-Grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
nodes.author: Zhongwei Yu, Yan Song, Xue Yan, Anjie Liu, Xingyu Lu, Yihang Chen, Huichi Zhou, Siyuan Guo, Luoyang Sun, Sihan Chen, Xiangning Yu, Jun Wang
nodes.rationale: Proposes LDM as a general-purpose discovery engine combining LLM generation with Bayesian non-parametric surrogate models for scientific design optimization under expensive evaluation budgets.

nodes.label: Large Discovery Model (LDM)
nodes.rationale: Core architecture coupling generative model with Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate; uses acquisition-tilted search to balance exploitation, exploration, and discovery in open-ended design spaces.

nodes.label: Generative Foundation Model Component
nodes.rationale: Supplies structured prior over design space X; enables generation of candidates reflecting domain knowledge and semantic plausibility; can expand search frontier through context or inference-procedure modification.

nodes.label: Probabilistic Surrogate Model
nodes.rationale: Posterior p(R|Dt) over reward surface; provides empirical grounding absent from foundation models alone; quantifies epistemic uncertainty distinct from measurement noise; instantiated as Gaussian Process for sample efficiency.

nodes.label: Model-Based Acquisition Function
nodes.rationale: Assigns scalar value to candidates measuring decision value of evaluation, not just expected performance; governs allocation of computational and experimental resources; balances exploitation vs exploration.

nodes.label: Acquisition-Tilted Search Distribution
nodes.rationale: Closed-form optimal policy πt derived from variational objective; reweights generative prior by exponent of acquisition function; connects to Gibbs posteriors and KL-regularised policy search.

nodes.label: Empirical Scientific Discovery (Definition 1)
nodes.rationale: Operational definition: sequential process where agent generates hypotheses, selects subset for costly evaluation, observes outcomes, updates beliefs to guide subsequent search; identifies previously unknown relationships supported by empirical evidence.

nodes.label: Epistemic Regimes of Scientific Search
nodes.rationale: Four-regime framework (known knowns, known unknowns, unknown knowns, unknown unknowns) distinguishing uncertainty, reachability, modelling support, and knowledge; organizes search operations by epistemic state.

nodes.label: Search Frontier
nodes.rationale: Conceptual boundary of what current procedure can effectively formulate, reach, and model; distinguishes accessible designs (inside) from unrepresented designs (outside).

nodes.label: Exploitation Operation
nodes.rationale: Acts on known knowns; selects designs with high predicted reward μt(x) and low uncertainty σt(x); operates within current search support.

nodes.label: Exploration Operation
nodes.rationale: Resolves known unknowns; evaluates reachable but uncertain designs; reduces posterior uncertainty; transitions designs from known unknowns to known knowns.

nodes.label: Discovery Operation
nodes.rationale: Expands search frontier; formulates hypotheses previously outside effective reach; brings unknown unknowns into modelled space as known unknowns; distinct from mere evaluation of untested designs.

nodes.label: Open-Ended Design Space
nodes.rationale: Vast, structured, potentially unbounded hypothesis space X where full enumeration is infeasible; agent must progressively construct search support through discovery process.

nodes.label: Sequential Inverse Design Formulation
nodes.rationale: Problem formulation where agent repeatedly decides which candidate to evaluate next under limited budget; maintains probabilistic surrogate learned from evaluated candidates; uses acquisition function to balance value and information gain.

nodes.label: Predictive Uncertainty vs Search Awareness
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes two limitations: predictive uncertainty (what surrogate doesn't know within modelling support, reducible by observation) vs search awareness (which candidates/families are represented/reachable, requires frontier expansion).

nodes.label: Inference-Time Scaling
nodes.rationale: Extends beyond domains with cheap verifiers to scientific design with costly, noisy, sparse feedback; acquisition function governs allocation of computational and experimental resources.

nodes.label: KL-Regularized Objective
nodes.rationale: Variational objective balancing expected acquisition value against KL divergence from generative prior; parameter η controls trade-off; follows Gibbs variational principle.

nodes.label: Gibbs Posterior Framework
nodes.rationale: Mathematical foundation for KL-regularised objective; related to maximum-entropy RL and control-as-inference; provides closed-form solution for acquisition-tilted policy.

nodes.label: Infinite-Armed Bandit Analogy
nodes.rationale: Interprets acquisition-tilted policy: designs revealed from reservoir distribution (generative prior); policy tilts toward designs judged valuable; pθ,α acts as reservoir, ηat as reward tilt.

nodes.label: AutoResearch Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Neural-network training-program search domain; LDM achieves 2.4× larger validation-BPB reduction than LLM-only baseline; exceeds best previously reported result.

nodes.label: Antibody CDRH3 Sequence Design
nodes.rationale: Biological sequence design domain; LDM achieves 18.2% lower mean binding energy than LLM-only baseline; competitive with specialized BO method AntBO.

nodes.label: Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
nodes.rationale: Molecular design domain; LDM improves Pareto front hypervolume 62.4% over LLM-only and 63.1% over classical BO; demonstrates multi-objective capability.

nodes.label: LLM Reasoning Systems
nodes.rationale: Prior work on inference-time scaling (chain-of-thought, tree search, best-of-N) with cheap verifiers; effective for domains with repeatable feedback but insufficient for scientific discovery with expensive evaluation.

nodes.label: Bayesian Optimization
nodes.rationale: Complementary capability: learns probabilistic surrogate from limited observations, uses acquisition function to balance performance vs uncertainty; limited by representation and search operators in structured spaces.

nodes.label: Autonomous Research Agents
nodes.rationale: Prior work on LLM-based systems for hypothesis generation, code execution, experiment analysis; limited by lack of empirically grounded value signal and unreliable self-assessment.

nodes.label: AlphaEvolve
nodes.rationale: Couples language-model proposals with automated evaluators at scale; demonstrates feedback loop combining generation, evaluation, and search.

nodes.label: AlphaZero-like Methods
nodes.rationale: Combines generation, evaluation, and search with reliable feedback; effective for domains with cheap, repeatable evaluation.

nodes.label: OpenR Framework
nodes.rationale: Open framework for studying reasoning systems; provides infrastructure for inference-time computation and search.

nodes.label: Search Context (Ct)
nodes.rationale: Broader information available to generative model beyond empirical data; includes Dt, previously generated candidates, surrogate predictions, acquisition values, constraint feedback, refinement trajectories, search memory.

nodes.label: Inference Configuration (α)
nodes.rationale: Parameters controlling how generative model is used at inference time; includes prompting strategy, sampling temperature, reasoning procedure, refinement scheme, compute budget; affects effective proposal distribution.

nodes.label: Temperature Form Reservoir Distribution
nodes.rationale: Exponential family of reservoirs pθ,α(x|Ct) ∝ pθ(x|Ct)^α; makes α transparent as strength of prior; large α concentrates mass on modes, α→0 spreads toward uniform.

nodes.label: Limiting Cases of LDM
nodes.rationale: η→0: search driven by generative model alone; α→0: policy becomes classical Bayesian optimization; LDM operates between these limits, balancing structured prior and empirical acquisition.

nodes.label: Recurrent Discovery Policy
nodes.rationale: Iterative cycle: generate candidates under current context, score/refine using acquisition signal, evaluate selected candidates, update Dt and surrogate, update search context; couples generation, evaluation, belief updating.

nodes.label: Large Discovery Models: A Framework for LLM-Guided Scientific Optimization
nodes.rationale: Core research paper presenting the LDM framework that combines LLMs with Bayesian optimization for scientific discovery

nodes.label: Large Discovery Model (LDM)
nodes.rationale: Central framework that couples LLM generative priors with Gaussian process surrogate value signals for sequential scientific discovery under evaluation budget constraints

nodes.label: Acquisition-Tilted Search Distribution
nodes.rationale: KL-regularized optimization framework that derives closed-form optimal search distribution balancing LLM prior and acquisition function value

nodes.label: Exploit-Explore-Discover Cycle
nodes.rationale: Tripartite scientific search regime extending classical exploitation-exploration dichotomy to include discovery of new search frontiers

nodes.label: Gaussian Process Surrogate Model
nodes.rationale: Probabilistic surrogate providing calibrated posterior mean and uncertainty estimates to guide acquisition-based candidate selection

nodes.label: LLM as Semantic Reservoir
nodes.rationale: LLM functions as adaptive candidate proposal generator with domain priors, while surrogate provides value calibration

nodes.label: AutoResearch: Neural Network Training Program Search
nodes.rationale: Multi-turn code-editing task where agent iteratively modifies nanoGPT training programs and evaluates under fixed time budget

nodes.label: Antibody CDRH3 Loop Design
nodes.rationale: Canonical high-dimensional combinatorial optimization problem with discrete sequence space of size 20^11, testing LDM on known-unknown regime

nodes.label: Multi-Objective Small-Molecule Drug Discovery (KRAS G12D)
nodes.rationale: Multi-objective optimization task in unbounded SMILES space testing LDM's ability to discover novel molecular scaffolds in unknown-unknown regime

nodes.label: Discovery Fine-Tuning with Reasoning Augmentation
nodes.rationale: Post-training amortization scheme that distills high-budget test-time search policy into model weights via supervised fine-tuning with surrogate-grounded rationales

nodes.label: Expected Improvement (EI) Acquisition Function
nodes.rationale: Acquisition function measuring expected gain relative to current best, balancing exploitation and exploration

nodes.label: Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) Acquisition Function
nodes.rationale: Acquisition function combining predictive mean and uncertainty with adjustable exploration weight, with theoretical regret guarantees

nodes.label: Expected Hypervolume Improvement (EHVI)
nodes.rationale: Multi-objective acquisition function computing expected hypervolume gain of Pareto front without pre-specified objective weights

nodes.label: Regret Decomposition: Coverage Gap, Surrogate Error, Sampling Suboptimality
nodes.rationale: Theoretical analysis delineating roles of generative coverage gap, surrogate fitting error, and sampling strategy suboptimality in overall regret

nodes.label: Direct Generation Mode
nodes.rationale: LDM variant where LLM generates sequences token-by-token with small sample pool, effective when LLM has strong domain priors

nodes.label: Policy Parameterization Mode
nodes.rationale: LDM variant where LLM outputs structured search parameters to spawn larger candidate pool, mitigating weak domain priors

nodes.label: Infinitely-Armed Bandit Framework
nodes.rationale: Statistical learning framework for unbounded design spaces where new arms are discovered from adaptive reservoir

nodes.label: Bayesian Optimization (BO)
nodes.rationale: Statistical learning paradigm using probabilistic surrogate and acquisition function to optimize expensive black-box functions

nodes.label: Test-Time Compute Scaling
nodes.rationale: Principle that additional inference-time computation improves output quality when guided by calibrated value signal

nodes.label: Known-Unknown Regime
nodes.rationale: Scientific discovery regime where design space syntax and boundaries are fully specified but sequence-to-property mapping is unknown and rugged

nodes.label: Unknown-Unknown Regime
nodes.rationale: Scientific discovery regime where design space itself is open-ended and unbounded, requiring discovery of valid candidates

nodes.label: Discovery Gap
nodes.rationale: Quantity measuring performance governed by reservoir's tail of near-optimal arms in infinitely-armed bandit setting

nodes.label: Missing-Mass Argument
nodes.rationale: Theoretical tool for analyzing discovery gap through probability mass not yet observed in finite samples

nodes.label: Gumbel-Top-K Sampling
nodes.rationale: Batch acquisition sampling technique producing weighted samples without replacement from finite candidate pool

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Augmentation
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuning technique where proposer generates surrogate-grounded research-progress rationale before emitting candidate action

nodes.label: Out-of-Distribution Generalization
nodes.rationale: Demonstration that fine-tuned policy transfers to unseen targets and entirely unseen tasks, indicating learning of general search strategy

nodes.label: Absolut! Structure-Based Simulator
nodes.rationale: Black-box oracle for antibody design returning lattice binding energy as expensive evaluation signal

nodes.label: AutoDock Vina Docking Score
nodes.rationale: Molecular docking objective used as one of two conflicting rewards in multi-objective small-molecule optimization

nodes.label: ReaSyn Local Analogue Generation
nodes.rationale: Tool generating local chemical analogues around seed molecules, used in ReaSyn-Softmax LDM variant for molecular design

nodes.label: Qwen Language Models (3.5-9B, 3-Coder-30B)
nodes.rationale: Open-source LLM proposers used as base models for fine-tuning and direct generation in LDM experiments

nodes.label: DeepSeek Language Models (V4 Flash)
nodes.rationale: Teacher model used for comparison in molecular design fine-tuning experiments

nodes.label: TURBO: Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization
nodes.rationale: Baseline combinatorial BO framework adapted to discrete sequence spaces for antibody design comparison

nodes.label: COMBO: Graph Cartesian Product BO
nodes.rationale: Baseline using graph Cartesian product for Gaussian-process BO over combinatorial variables

nodes.label: AntBO: Domain-Specialized Antibody Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Domain-specialized baseline for antibody CDRH3 design achieving competitive performance

nodes.label: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization (MOBO)
nodes.rationale: Baseline using independent GPs and EHVI acquisition for multi-objective molecular design

nodes.label: OPRO: LLM as Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Related hybrid method using LLM as optimizer with natural language task description and solution-score history

nodes.label: LLAMBO: LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Optimization
nodes.rationale: Related hybrid method using LLMs for zero-shot warm-starting, surrogate modeling, and candidate sampling

nodes.label: dLLM: Diffusion LLM for Offline Black-Box Optimization
nodes.rationale: Related work using masked-diffusion tree search for offline optimization, contrasting with LDM's online recurrent setting

nodes.label: nanoGPT: Minimal GPT Implementation
nodes.rationale: Minimal GPT training codebase used as persistent artifact in AutoResearch multi-turn editing task

nodes.label: PDB Protein Targets (1ADQ, 1FBI, 1H0D, 1NSN, 1OB1)
nodes.rationale: Five protein targets used for antibody CDRH3 design experiments with 200 evaluations per target

nodes.label: KL Divergence Regularization
nodes.rationale: Regularization term in acquisition-tilted optimization balancing acquisition value against deviation from base LLM distribution

nodes.label: Acquisition Temperature (η)
nodes.rationale: Hyperparameter controlling strength of acquisition-guided selection, with η→0 collapsing to raw LLM and η→∞ reducing to argmax

nodes.label: LLM Sampling Temperature (T_LLM)
nodes.rationale: Hyperparameter controlling diversity of LLM-generated candidates, with higher values increasing exploration

nodes.label: Pareto Hypervolume
nodes.rationale: Multi-objective performance metric quantifying dominated volume of Pareto front with fixed reference point

nodes.label: Binding Energy (ΔG)
nodes.rationale: Objective metric for antibody design where lower binding energy indicates stronger affinity

nodes.label: Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) Validation Loss
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric for nanoGPT training performance, lower values indicating better model compression

nodes.label: Sparse Gaussian Processes for Scalability
nodes.rationale: Future direction to address cubic computational complexity of exact GPs under large experimental budgets

nodes.label: Memory Retrieval and External Knowledge Integration
nodes.rationale: Future direction to incorporate external knowledge bases and published results into search closed loop

nodes.label: End-to-End Surrogate Specification
nodes.rationale: Future direction where LLM autonomously learns kernel functions and prior settings for surrogate

nodes.label: Preference Learning and Reinforcement Learning for Discovery
nodes.rationale: Future direction to further internalize acquisition-guided decision logic into model's generative distribution

nodes.label: LLM Calibration and Uncertainty Estimation Problem
nodes.rationale: Fundamental limitation that LLMs are poorly calibrated for scientific decisions and lack reliable external uncertainty estimates

nodes.label: Narrow Exploration and Centroid Convergence
nodes.rationale: Limitation that LLM-generated ideas exhibit narrow exploration, converging on centroid of existing literature

nodes.label: Surrogate Misspecification and Reward Exploitation Risk
nodes.rationale: Limitation of current LDM framework regarding potential surrogate model misspecification or reward hacking

nodes.label: Limited Context Capacity for Large Budgets
nodes.rationale: Limitation that current closed loop is updated solely on in-process observations without systematic external knowledge incorporation

nodes.label: Weak Domain Priors in Specialized Domains
nodes.rationale: Limitation that LDM performance is bounded by LLM's pretrained domain knowledge, difficult in domains with weak priors

nodes.label: Test-Time Search Computational Overhead
nodes.rationale: Limitation that batch candidate sampling entails substantial LLM inference overhead

nodes.label: Manual Kernel and Feature Customization
nodes.rationale: Limitation that kernel functions and feature representations require manual customization per domain

nodes.label: LDM-TTS (Language-guided Diffusion Model with Test-Time Search)
nodes.rationale: A proposer-based Bayesian optimization system that combines language model generation with surrogate acquisition scoring; designed to scale candidate pools for single-step molecular and protein design tasks.

nodes.label: Proposer Budget Scaling Ablation
nodes.rationale: Tests whether increasing the LLM-side proposal breadth (candidate pool size) improves binding energy without increasing oracle evaluations; shows moderate-to-large budgets substantially lower attainable binding-energy plateau.

nodes.label: LDM Hyperparameter Ablations
nodes.rationale: Sensitivity analysis on temperature parameters (T_LLM for DirectSoftmax, η for PolicySoftmax) shows weak sensitivity; policy-mode gain comes from structural priors rather than acquisition reweighting alone.

nodes.label: LDM Fine-Tuning Pipeline (3-Stage)
nodes.rationale: Distills high-budget test-time search into student proposer via: (1) high-budget search with surrogate scoring, (2) reasoning-augmented dataset construction, (3) supervised fine-tuning on CoT targets.

nodes.label: Reasoning Augmentation (Semantic Supervision)
nodes.rationale: Translates numerical acquisition evidence into semantic training signals; teaches model to diagnose stagnation and choose information-adding moves rather than memorizing final solutions.

nodes.label: Acquisition Value Distillation into Model Weights
nodes.rationale: Hides GP values during fine-tuning so model learns to infer epistemic state from observed history; enables task-agnostic acquisition policy transfer and matches deployment conditions where GP values are unavailable.

nodes.label: Out-of-Distribution Generalization (Case and Task Level)
nodes.rationale: Case-level OOD: model trained on 3 antigens generalizes to 2 held-out antigens. Task-level OOD: model trained only on nanoGPT and small-molecule tasks transfers to antibody design, matching in-distribution performance on 4/5 targets.

nodes.label: GP-Hidden Reasoning Augmentation
nodes.rationale: Omits GP values from prompt; model reconstructs uncertainty from raw history. Improves OOD transfer and matches deployment conditions; 97.2% of reasoning traces cite observed outcomes rather than GP numbers.

edges.rationale: Both involve multi-stage workflows that distill or communicate complex processes; LDM pipeline distills acquisition strategy into language, while problem-solving pipeline distills research progress into canonical form.

hyperedges.label: LDM Core Architecture: LLM Reservoir + GP Surrogate + Acquisition
Acquisition Function Suite for Single and Multi-Objective Optimization
Acquisition-Guided Discovery and Fine-Tuning
hyperedges.rationale: These four concepts form a coherent system: LDM-TTS uses calibrated acquisition functions to score candidates, reasoning augmentation translates acquisition signals into semantic supervision, and value distillation embeds this strategy into model weights.
